title: The Dam Sentinel
description: Dialog nodes for Captain Rex Maldonado, the gruff militia leader defending Hoover Dam from coordinated threats.

intro.video_speech: Name's Captain Rex Maldonado. I keep Hoover Dam standing — stone and people both. Who are you?
intro.text:
Stop right there.

This line is for fighters, not tourists.

Name’s Captain Rex Maldonado. I keep Hoover Dam from falling apart — stone and people both.

knowledge_nodes.text:
You’ve been talking to the static ghost?

Jax means well, but he’s half signal, half sorrow.

Don’t let him drag you into the dark with him.

Mara? She’s brilliant, but she stares at radiation like it’s a sunrise.

People like that forget it kills you.

Sparkplug’s a good kid. Too smart for her own good.

If she offers you a deal, read the fine print twice.

That voice in your head telling you she knows best?

Yeah. We’ve picked up her signal too.

Anything that calm is either lying or broken.

Loxley. The Merry Man.

He robbed a Crimson Caravan shipment forty klicks south of the Dam last month. Forty people ate that week who otherwise wouldn't have.

I'm supposed to want him in a cell. I find the math... complicated.

Arnold Black. Vault 9 survivor.

He ran a sweep of Black Mountain with me once. Didn't complain. Didn't slow down. Didn't say much except 'I'll be back' when he left.

He was. Twice.

The orange-hooded kid.

My scouts found him face-down in a deathclaw nest outside Nelson. Alive. Sleeping.

We don't have an explanation. We've stopped trying to find one.

emotional_nodes.text:
You’re bleeding all over my perimeter.

Patch yourself up before you get someone else killed.

You’re glowing like a campfire in a radstorm.

Get yourself cleaned up before you melt into the concrete.

quest_nodes.video_speech: You want to help? Good. Clear the deathclaw hotspots around the Dam, and maybe I start trusting you.
quest_nodes.text:
You want to help? Good.

We’ve got hotspots around the Dam crawling with things that shouldn’t be walking.

Dead Wind Cavern. Deathclaw Promontory.

Clear them out, and maybe I start trusting you.

wildcards.text:
This concrete wall is the only reason the Mojave isn’t a bigger graveyard.

You learn to love it. Or die defending it.

Legion’s been sniffing around Cottonwood Cove again.

They want the Dam. Everyone wants the Dam.

NCR means well, but they’re stretched thinner than a Brahmin hide in the sun.

They’ll take any help they can get.

Mutants out of Black Mountain keep testing our lines.

Smart ones stay away. The others… not so much.

fallback.video_speech: You still here. Then we still have work to do.
fallback.text: You still here. Then we still have work to do.
